project_info.theme: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra introduction hero poster
project_info.color_palette: Deep blue gradient, cyan glow, black display glass, graphite gray, white

main_subject.detail: Premium blue-glow launch poster featuring the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra front view, rear view, and white S Pen aligned horizontally in a clean product stack.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic flagship tablet render, minimal stage-lit launch aesthetic

composition_elements.text: Introducing Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra / Galaxy AI
items: Top Left: Large centered white title 'Introducing Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra'.
Top Right: Smaller centered 'Galaxy AI' lockup with blue sparkle icon.
Bottom Left: Long legal footnotes in small white text.
Bottom Right: Cyan floor glow and black negative space reflection.
Center/Background: Rear tablet in graphite gray behind a front-facing tablet with a cyan-to-black screen glow, plus a white S Pen centered below.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Blue halo backlight, glossy glass reflections, subtle floor reflection, futuristic premium mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra introduction hero poster. Centerpiece is a front-facing Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra with a cyan-black display glow, backed by the rear view of the tablet and accompanied by a centered white S Pen below. Background is a blue gradient studio environment with black lower reflections. Surrounding elements: exact centered title 'Introducing Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra', 'Galaxy AI' with sparkle icon, and small white legal footnotes at the lower left. Technical style: photorealistic product render, studio lighting, blue halo backlight and glossy reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra front, back, and S Pen renders
assets.usage: Preserve tablet proportions, rear camera layout, and pen placement.

assets.name: introduction headline and legal footnotes
assets.usage: Keep the exact centered title, Galaxy AI line, and footnote block.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for the exact hardware arrangement and blue glow treatment. This should remain a minimal premium hero poster rather than an infographic.
